A '''tropical fish''' is a common ⭐☆☆☆ [[fish]] caught by [[fishing]] in [[Fishing#Warm saltwater|warm]] and [[Fishing#Hot saltwater|hot saltwater]]. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Tropical Fish|tropical fish}} with a rarity line. Unlike in vanilla, it can be cooked, into [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]], and a [[Fisherman]] buys 12 caught tropical fish for an [[Obol]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
The tropical fish can be caught in these climate tables.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/saltwater_warm.json}}</ref> <ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/saltwater_hot.json}}</ref> The chances are per cast of a [[Fishing Rod|fishing rod]] and include the junk and treasure rolls.
{| class="wikitable"
! Climate !! Biomes !! Weight !! Per catch (open water) !! Per catch (other water) !! Per catch ({{MCW|Luck of the Sea}} III)
|-
| [[Fishing#Warm saltwater|Warm saltwater]] || Lukewarm Ocean, Deep Lukewarm Ocean || 15 of 42 || 30.36% || 31.95% || 30.19%
|-
| [[Fishing#Hot saltwater|Hot saltwater]] || Warm Ocean || 15 of 42 || 30.36% || 31.95% || 30.19%
|}

The same tables are also rolled by the fisherman's house chest in [[Village|villages]] and by the {{MCW|Elder Guardian|elder guardian}}'s drops, using the biome at the chest or where the elder guardian dies.

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Raw fish can be eaten, but it heals nothing: Matcha Flavoured removes [[hunger]], and food only heals through the hearts shown on its tooltip. Cooked, it becomes [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]], which heals {{Hp|4}}.

=== Cooking ===
{{Cooking|station=Oven|Input=Tropical Fish|Output=Cooked Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Kindling|Input=Tropical Fish|Output=Cooked Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Mud Kiln|Input=Tropical Fish|Output=Charred Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}}

The recipes match any <code>minecraft:tropical_fish</code>, so every tropical fish gives the same result.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_tropical_fish.json}}</ref> A [[Mud Kiln]] burns it into [[Charred Fish|charred fish]] instead.

=== Trading ===
The [[Fisherman]] buys 12 caught tropical fish for 1 [[Obol]] once he reaches Apprentice level. Only fish with the ⭐☆☆☆ rarity line, which the fishing loot tables add, are accepted.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fisherman/2/tropical_fish.json}}</ref>

{{Uses}}

== Angler's Almanac ==
The [[Angler's Almanac]] has an entry for the tropical fish under Hot Saltwater (listed chance 35.7%) and Warm Saltwater (listed chance 35.7%), unlocked by catching one after the player has obtained the almanac.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> Its description reads:
<blockquote>''A brilliantly colorful reef fish available in more patterns than anyone reasonably needs.''</blockquote>

== Advancements ==
* '''No More Fish in the Sea''' – catch every fish, including this one. Rewards 10 [[Obol]]s.
* '''Fishmonger''' – sell caught fish to a Fisherman.
